Interface TradingCalendarRuleSetJpaRepository

All Superinterfaces:
BaseRepositoryCustom<TradingCalendarRuleSet>, org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<TradingCalendarRuleSet, Integer>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<TradingCalendarRuleSet, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<TradingCalendarRuleSet, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<TradingCalendarRuleSet, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<TradingCalendarRuleSet, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<TradingCalendarRuleSet>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<TradingCalendarRuleSet, Integer>, TradingCalendarRuleSetJpaRepositoryCustom, UpdateCreateJpaRepository<TradingCalendarRuleSet>
public interface TradingCalendarRuleSetJpaRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<TradingCalendarRuleSet, Integer>, TradingCalendarRuleSetJpaRepositoryCustom, UpdateCreateJpaRepository<TradingCalendarRuleSet>
Repository for the trading calendar rule sets, the shared data from which the closures of a stock exchange can be calculated instead of deriving them from the quotes of a reference index.

    • findByMic

      Optional<TradingCalendarRuleSet> findByMic(String mic)
      Finds the rule set written for a market identifier code. Used when a stock exchange is created with that MIC, so the matching rule set can be assigned without the user having to look it up.
      Parameters:
      mic - the market identifier code
      Returns:
      the rule set carrying this MIC, or empty when none does

    • findByName

      Optional<TradingCalendarRuleSet> findByName(String name)

    • countUsingStockexchanges

      @Query(nativeQuery=true) int countUsingStockexchanges(Integer idTradingCalendarRuleSet)
      Counts the stock exchanges that currently calculate their trading calendar from the given rule set. A rule set that is still in use must not be deleted. Named query: TradingCalendarRuleSet.countUsingStockexchanges
      Parameters:
      idTradingCalendarRuleSet - the rule set to check
      Returns:
      number of referencing stock exchanges, never null

    • countUsingStockexchangesGrouped

      @Query(nativeQuery=true) List<TradingCalendarRuleSetJpaRepository.IdRuleSetUsage> countUsingStockexchangesGrouped()
      Returns the number of referencing stock exchanges for every rule set, so the overview table can show at a glance which rule sets are in use. Rule sets without a single exchange are absent from the result. Named query: TradingCalendarRuleSet.countUsingStockexchangesGrouped
      Returns:
      rows of rule set id and usage count
